podcast.title: Bauhaus Guitar Roadie
podcast.body: Glenn Campling was the guitar roadie for Bauhaus before joining Daniel Ash and Kevin Haskins in their post-Bauhaus project, Tones on Tail. "Glenn Campling, the Bajaus guitar rowdy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About Bauhaus?
